text: APPROVE. `GatherLcov` is now a single loop calling two small helpers, so its cognitive complexity drops well under 15. The `continue` in the old `catch (IOException)` becomes a `return` in the helper, so a failed read still skips to the next file and keeps any partial BRF/BRH totals through the `ref long` parameters. The `CHA0004` pragma still wraps the catch, so I see no new build warning.
